scope: One bounded same-instance Chisel witness joins the separately-bound C2 R1/R2 wrapper drain facts with the corresponding existing publication-wrapper facts before the unchanged R6 collector, and records observed event order through legal C2 response backpressure.

boundary.scope: testbench-only C2 drain membership and event-scoreboard evidence
boundary.joiner: testbench RouteARTL37cDrainMembershipJoin; accepts only matching asserted existing status facts and emits one existing fact
boundary.r1_facts: mem_init_done followed by R1 drain; both publication and C2 R1 wrappers must participate
boundary.r2_facts: payload drain and descriptor drain; both publication and C2 R2 wrappers must participate
boundary.collector_owner: existing R6 collector and status-code set are unchanged
boundary.event_oracle: host-side RouteARTL37cEventScoreboard records only observed ready/valid milestones
boundary.unclosed: C2 demand/publication/descriptor/lease grants remain verification facts; C1 sidecar fixture transport and static partial/R4 fixtures remain; no production common-memory, controller, or top composition

invariants: a joined status is emitted only after publication and C2 wrappers assert the same existing logical fact
a joined status holds its exact payload stable under ready-low
C2 R1/R2 status cannot bypass the existing R6 collector through an added status or owner
legal C2 response backpressure delays but does not remove the request or change observed event order
a stale pre-reset C2 response cannot restart the fresh composed path before both R1 wrappers reinitialize
a matching packed endpoint terminal fault cannot deposit payload, make S2 READY, or emit a release
this bounded evidence makes no deadlock, timing, throughput, PPA, production-RTL, model/GPU, or A4-DSE claim

chisel_commands: cd hardware/route_a/chisel && env JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 sbt -batch 'testOnly kvpress.routea.rtl2.RouteARTL265eSameInstanceWitnessSpec -- -z "retains event order"'
cd hardware/route_a/chisel && env JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 sbt -batch 'testOnly kvpress.routea.rtl2.RouteARTL265eSameInstanceWitnessSpec -- -z "rejects a stale C2 response"'
cd hardware/route_a/chisel && env JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 sbt -batch 'testOnly kvpress.routea.rtl2.RouteAPackedS2ReadPathSpec -- -z "converts a matching terminal R1 fault"'
evidence_labels: no cycle timing throughput deadlock claim
